metadata.description: The ORBITS Flow — a gated, metric-anchored working agreement for shipping software with agents

plugins.name: orbits-flow
plugins.description: Six stages from a measured problem to a verified fix — Overview, Resolve, Break down, Implement, Test, Ship. Each ends at a gate a person opens. Adds the ORBITS skill plus /orbits commands for running the flow, batching gates on autopilot, briefing implementers, clearing permissions, and closing the loop on the number.
